items.headline: Rip Current Statement issued October 8 at 2:06PM EDT until October 10 at 8:00PM EDT by NWS Tampa Bay Ruskin FL
items.description:
* WHAT...Dangerous rip currents expected.

* WHERE...Coastal Manatee, Coastal Sarasota, Coastal Charlotte
and Coastal Lee Counties.

* WHEN...From Friday morning through Saturday evening.

* IMPACTS...Rip currents can sweep even the best swimmers away
from shore into deeper water.
items.instruction:
Swim near a lifeguard. If caught in a rip current, relax and
float. Don't swim against the current. If able, swim in a
direction following the shoreline. If unable to escape, face the
shore and call or wave for help.

items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued October 9 at 5:45AM EDT until October 10 at 4:00PM EDT by NWS Tampa Bay Ruskin FL
items.description:
* WHAT...East winds around 20 knots with gusts up to 30 knots.

* WHERE...Coastal waters from Bonita Beach to Englewood out to 60
NM including Charlotte Harbor.

* WHEN...From 8 AM this morning to 4 PM EDT Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
